name: Cult of Sotek
startIntroPart2: Tehenhauin believes that with sufficient sacrifices, the serpent-god may yet return, bringing salvation to the Lizardmen and the extermination of the Skaven.
declaringWar: You will be a sacrifice for the Serpent god!
attacked: You incur the wrath of the Serpent God!
introduction: Hello, we want two things: sacrifices and the extermination of the Skaven.
neutralNo: Sorry, but this is not in my best interest.
hateHello: Why are you wasting my time now?
hateNo: That is an insult for the Serpent-God!
hateYes: I must admit it will benefit us both.
afterPeace: Finally, I can go back chopping rats.
